texts: Reduction of cumulative carbon 2026-2050 vs the Reference (kt CO₂e; exact Shapley value)
note: Shapley values within each combined game (Reference -> Moderate Pathway, -> Ambitious Pathway, -> TL); standalone effects in ED7. The TL dots are Shapley values within the TL game, so they include interactions at the limit (L5 with L4). Sum over levers (= Reference - Pathway / TL, exact): moderate 5,460 kt, ambitious 9,494 kt, tl 15,339 kt; 512 subsets per game. Strategy-level Shapley values (Moderate / Ambitious; 8 subsets): S1 Avoid 3,498 / 6,060 kt; S2 Switch 1,431 / 2,482 kt; S3 Improve 530 / 952 kt.
